name: Bun rieu cua
summary: Crab noodle soup. Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định says the crab is pounded, mixed with egg, and set into brown-gold sheets, with seaweed in the pot and a full herb plate.
origin: Quy Nhon. The provincial portal ties the bowl to the silt of the Kôn River and addresses it to the city.
texture: The portal says the crab custard sets into sheets you can break with chopsticks.
howToEat: Eat it with the herb plate: shredded banana flower, perilla, rau răm, bean sprouts, young lettuce, and other herbs.
A street and a clock were not printed. Check on arrival.
where: The address field is Quy Nhon. A street was not printed.
